```{mermaid}
%%| label: fig-statistical-test-selection-flowchart
%%| fig-cap: "Statistical test selection flowchart"
%%| file: test_selection_flowchart.mmd
```

```{=html}
<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
  // Give Quarto/Mermaid time to render the inline SVG before enabling pan/zoom
  setTimeout(function () {
    document.querySelectorAll("div.cell-output-display svg").forEach(function (svg) {
      svg.closest(".cell-output-display").classList.add("mermaid-zoom-container");
      svgPanZoom(svg, {
        zoomEnabled: true,
        controlIconsEnabled: true,
        fit: true,
        center: true,
        minZoom: 0.5,
        maxZoom: 10
      });
    });
  }, 500);
});
</script>
```
